Referral-graph admission stops bulk fakes by tying every new agent to a verifiable sponsor chain.

A sponsor locks 120 units for 12 epochs, endorsing at most 3 per epoch; density above 0.6 triggers review. Shared funding trails surface like karst springs, and one proven fake freezes the chain, an echo reaching its nadir.

1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors locking 40,080 units; a 40% detection rate costs over 16,000 units plus a 10-epoch ban.
